thread.title: Instagram: Time to Tune in for Some IGTV

title: Instagram: Time to Tune in for Some IGTV
text:
David Marino-Nachison June 20, 2018 2:52 p.m. ET
Like watching video on Facebook ? Facebook’s (FB) got you covered. Don’t like watching video on Facebook? Facebook’s got you covered: On Wednesday, Instagram announced IGTV , an app for watching videos up to an hour long.
The app offers some integration with the main Instagram app: You can watch IGTV videos within the “core” app, send them to Instagram friends, and automatically see content from people who follow without searching. Newsletter Sign-up
IGTV “will be rolling out globally over the next few weeks” on Alphabet’s (GOOGL) Android and Apple ’s (AAPL) iOS operating systems, according to the launch announcement. When it does, it could reach a pretty big audience, since Instagram—increasingly seen as core to Facebook’s growth —today said it has 1 billion members. (Apple, Facebook and Alphabet are all Barron’s Next 50 stocks.)
Doing this as a separate app, meanwhile, could be an effective way to keep Instagram from feeling cluttered with a combination of photos, short images and animations, and the new, longer, content. More About Barron’s Next The Barron’s Next 50
Facebook, the company, wants to keep giving people reasons to use its properties while finding more ways to serve advertisers. Yesterday, a Facebook executive told Recode it would start running autoplay video ads in Messenger , another property launched as a kind of spinoff-app, this week.
Facebook, the stock, has been on quote a run. Today it topped $200 per share for the first time ever, part of a string of record highs. ( Barron’s Jon Swartz has more on that .)
